what_it_shows: Cell Phones department: Unlocked, Apple iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, Motorola, Android, refurbished, with plans, prepaid, SIM cards, kids and senior phones; browse by type and by carrier; accessories (chargers, power banks, cases) are a separate sibling

E-book readers are their own category, filtered by screen size (under 6, 6 to 7, 7 plus inches), built-in light, waterproofing, network type, panel type (Carta, Kaleido), storage; sits next to tablet PC and tablet cases in related categories

Guide separates Tablets, E-readers and Digital Pads (drawing/input tablets) as three device types; tablets by screen-size bands (under 7, 7.1-9, 9.1-11, over 11 in); E-readers by screen type (E-ink, Kaleido colour), library, audiobooks

Phone finder facets: brand, year, availability, price, network, form factor (bar, flip up, flip down, slide, swivel, watch, other, foldable), QWERTY, IP rating, back/frame material, OS (feature phones, Android, iOS, KaiOS...); tablets via a mode switch

Phone form factors: bar (incl. keyboard bar, brick, slate, phablet, multi-screen, taco), movable-section forms (clamshell/flip, foldable, slider, swivel, mixed), wearables (smartwatch); phablet defined by screen over 5.3 in
Smartphone range = price-based segmentation: budget under 200 USD, mid-range 300-500, premium over 800; foldables a premium subcategory; update-support length and satellite SOS vary by tier
Wearable Technology department: Smartwatches, Smart Rings, Fitness Trackers, Smart Glasses, then accessories (bands, chargers, screen protectors, ring accessories); wristwatches a related category

Garmin wearables facets: case size (small, medium, large), battery life bands, built-in GPS, display type (AMOLED, MicroLED, hidden, screenless), connectivity (BT calls, cellular, cellular and satellite), series (fenix, Instinct, Venu, vivoactive, vivosmart, Forerunner); activity sub-lines (running, multisport, golf, diving, kids, hybrid, luxury)

Handheld GPS divided by a maker-assigned level (Entry, Advanced, Premium) plus display size, battery type (rechargeable or AA), connectivity (2-way radio, inReach satellite); lines eTrex, GPSMAP 65, Rino
Satellite communicators (inReach) are a separate outdoor-recreation category next to handhelds, adventure watches and service plans; plans are a subscription outside the device
Telefon department: Mobiltelefone (Handys ohne Vertrag, cases, Smartwatches and Sportuhren), Festnetz (landline), Hobbyfunk (radios: Funkgeraete, accessories, scanners)

Mobiltelefone subcategories: phones without contract (presets Android 17, Android 16, Featurephones; maker, listing year, storage, OS), Smartwatches and Sportuhren (Android/iOS compatibility), modems and routers, mobile chargers (power banks, by maker), accessories

Telekommunikation: Smartwatches (maker and line chips: Garmin, Apple, Suunto, Polar, fenix, Apple Watch; Sportuhr; iOS or Android), phone accessories (cases, Powerbanks, chargers, spare parts), smartwatch accessories; tablets and phones are siblings
Smartwatches guide opens with standalone (own SIM/eSIM) versus second-screen watches, then OS (Wear OS, iOS), then functions; Fitness-Tracker is a sibling product type under Smartwatches

Xiaomi range: Mobile (phones by series Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO; tablets), Wearables (smart watches, smart bands, TWS, smart glasses, smart tags), and Chargings (power banks, adapters, wireless chargers, cables)
Chinese IT portal front page: sections mobile, smartwear, dcdv, diy; articles show buyer-facing groupings (small-screen flagship, gaming phones, thousand-yuan tier) but no category tree

Kimovil ranks phones by a Ki cost-effective score and has Range = Low / Mid / High-end plus price bands (under 100...1500 USD), 62 filters (screen, glass, IP, rugged, foldable, AnTuTu score, RAM, stylus, gaming buttons)
AnTuTu publishes monthly charts for three market categories: flagship, mid-range and tablets, ranked by average AnTuTu 12 score (China data); shows a measured ordering inside tier bands
AnTuTu ranking pages split Android/iOS, Performance/SoC/AI, Smartphone/Pad; score is the average of valid device data

HS/CN heading 8517: telephone sets incl. smartphones (8517.13), other phones for cellular or wireless networks (8517.14), line phones (8517.11), network apparatus (8517.62); smartphone is its own subheading

Power banks and phone battery cases are regulated as spare lithium batteries: carry-on only, limit 100 Wh per battery (101-160 Wh with airline approval); watt-hour rating is a regulatory band for power banks
IEC 60529 IP code: two numerals, solids 0-6, liquids 0-9; used on phones, wearables and trackers as the recognised durability grade
IETF DULT working group standardises how location-tracking accessories (trackers) and nearby devices handle unwanted tracking; defines trackers as a class of accessory across makers

Used-tech marketplace top level: iPhones, Phones (incl. unlocked), Laptops, Computers, Watches and Wearables, Tablets and iPads, Gaming, Audio, Drones, Home Tech, Cameras, Fitness; phones, tablets and watches are three separate sections; sell flows ask for exact model and a condition grade

Used smartphone and tablet shop with a six-step condition rank (S new/unused, A near-mint, B good, C fair, D flawed, J junk); filters by maker/line (iPhone, Xperia, Galaxy, Apple Watch, iPad), carrier lock (Docomo, SoftBank, au); condition is a modifier, not a kind

E-reader community matrix organised by screen size class (5, 6, large/document viewers 9-13 in) and screen technology (E Ink Vizplex/Pearl/Carta, SiPix, colour); columns: formats, DRM, touch, stylus, storage, bookstore services; separate LCD matrix

E-book devices: current e-paper readers, document viewers (9 in and up), non-ink readers (LCD), future and discontinued; 336 devices listed; general tablets, PDAs and smartphones noted as alternative readers
Personal locator beacons (SOS only, no subscription, multiyear battery) versus satellite messengers (two-way text, subscription, rechargeable); choice is by service and network, then features
Two-way radios by service: FRS (licence-free, 2 W cap) versus GMRS (licence, more power, repeaters); then range, weather alerts, texting; same-brand pairs interoperate best

Handheld GPS bought on three axes: size of unit versus screen, touch or buttons, advanced features (barometer, compass, wireless, satellite messenger); phone apps and satellite messengers treated as neighbours
Walkie talkies chosen first by radio service not brand: FRS, GMRS, FCC Part 90 business radio, push-to-talk over cellular; UK PMR446 not valid in US

Bluetooth item trackers are locked to a finding network: Apple Find My (AirTag), Google Find Hub (Chipolo, Pebblebee), Samsung SmartThings Find (SmartTag), Tile's own; network decides which phone works

PDA collection explored by guided tours ordered by chronology or by size; defines PDA as 1990s-2000s personal-information handheld, also called palmtops, organizers, handheld PCs, PC companions; ordering axis is chronology and size, not maker
Computer History Museum PalmPilot exhibit: handheld bridged the separate worlds of electronic organizer, PC and later mobile phone; history told by lineage (Psion, HP LX, Newton, EO, Zoomer, Palm)

Electronic organizer defined as calculator-sized diary computer with keypad and 1-3 line LCD, superseded by PDAs, palmtops and smartphones; template groups handheld devices: organizer, e-reader, handheld game console, handheld PC, mobile phone (camera, feature, smartphone, foldable), tablet (detachable, phablet)

Smartphone and mobile department: smartphones (browse by OS iOS/Android/Windows, by carrier), smartwatches and wearables, activity meters, outdoor GPS, phone accessories, mobile batteries; power banks sit in the home-appliance tree, not with phones

Wearables facets: type (smartwatch vs smart band), OS (Watch OS, Wear OS), case shape and size, battery days, GPS, Suica payment, fall detection, blood-oxygen, ECG, use (running, golf, ski); about 820 products

Smartwatch defined as wearable computer resembling a wristwatch; sport watch/GPS watch and activity tracker overlap; template groups wearables: fitness tracker (smart band), digital wristwatch (calculator watch, smartwatch, sportwatch), smartglasses, smart ring; watch OS list (watchOS, Wear OS, Fitbit OS, Zepp OS, HarmonyOS)

E-reader choice is \\\\\\\"which bookstore you want to live in\\\\\\\": Kindle (Amazon DRM), Kobo (EPUB, library borrowing built in, Kobo Plus), Boox (Android e-ink tablet, any store app); then colour vs mono, size, buttons, stylus, waterproofing
Apple tablet lineup as maker-set tiers: base iPad, iPad mini, iPad Air, iPad Pro, separated by chip, RAM, display tech, Apple Pencil and keyboard support; shows a maker tier ladder inside one family
